audit.whatIsWrong: Full and content charts disagreed on three rows: Level 2 (Skill vs Ryze), Level 3 (Veigar vs Ryze) and First item (Ryze vs Veigar). The full layer had the first-item row backwards — that is Veigar's Luden's flip, not Ryze's window.
audit.why: Content whys are kit-grounded: rune-charged Overload wins extended trades levels 3-9; Veigar's uncapped AP passes Ryze's fixed scaling from first item.
audit.corrected: Full rows 1, 2 and 5 aligned to content with matching whys.

audit.why: Spikes: even 1-2, Ryze 3-5 and near-peak at level 9/first item, Veigar full build with a skill-dependent last stage — content spikes[] accurate.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated: Rune Prison only ROOTS if Spell Flux is already applied — otherwise it merely slows. No cooldown digits anywhere (packet defect).
audit.why: Kit: W 'If the target has Flux on it, they are instead rooted'; W 11-9s, Q 5s with resets, E 3.5-2.5s, R 180/160/140s.
audit.corrected: Flux-gates-root stated in dosFull[1].d and breakdown.cooldowns with real numbers; Realm Warp downtime named as the all-in window.

edits.before: Ryze wins by landing Rune Prison (Root), denying your pattern, and keeping the fight at a distance your kit resents.
edits.after: Ryze wins by tagging you with Spell Flux, rooting through it with Rune Prison, and unloading rune-charged Overloads.

edits.before: W on cage-stunned or rooted targets only — uncaged Dark Matter is a donation to his dodge stats.
edits.after: His rune-empowered Q combo out-DPSes you in any extended trade from level 3 — poke and disengage.

edits.before: Cage online: drop it ON yourself when he engages, behind him when he farms — the geometry does the fighting.
edits.after: Through the mid levels his faster clear and sustained damage control the tempo — cage stays defensive.

edits.before: Luden's spike: cage-W-Q-R deletes squishies who touch the wall. Your zone is a courtroom now.
edits.after: Luden's spike: your uncapped AP starts passing his fixed scaling — a landed cage is now a kill.

edits.before: - Ryze Rune Prison (Root): matchup-defining — Point-blank root — respect the EQ chain that follows it. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E Event Horizon (self-cage) like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Rune Prison is 11s at rank 1 and only roots through Spell Flux — no purple debuff, no root. - Overload cycles every 5s with resets and E every 3.5s; never trade into a double-rune charge. - Realm Warp is 180s — while it is down he cannot escape your cage combo.

edits.before: W-ing open ground on a moving target and trading uncaged 'just to stack' — Veigar without the wall is a piggy bank with a hat.
edits.after: His Overload spam clears and pokes on a 5s cooldown — contesting every shove head-on feeds him free rune-charged EQ trades.

edits.before: Cage his step-up, W the edge-stun, Q-auto, and walk — a half-bar trade that also deposited three stacks into the curve.
edits.after: Cage the Overload step-up, W the edge-stun, add Q and an auto, then leave — a half-bar trade with three stacks banked.

notes: Chart: full rows 1, 2 and 5 aligned to the content chart (win[] already correct, sides edited alone with matching whys per the chart rule) — the full layer's first-item row had the sides inverted, crediting Ryze with Veigar's Luden's window. Key interaction added: Rune Prison roots only through Spell Flux (kit-explicit), which changes when it is safe to trade. Rows 0, 3, 4, 6 agree at Skill and content whys ground them — full whys for those rows remain generic templates; recorded in sectionsMissing. wants.you[3] 'Punish Ryze's melee range' is wrong (615-range mage, not melee) but the string sits at the 25-char skip boundary where an edit risks rejection — reported here instead of edited.
